summary: Audited Gizmo's Svelte frontend across 76 components and ~5,400 lines of CSS, then published an HTML report listing 4 defects, 12 friction points, 8 refactors, and a sequenced order of work. Found one critical rendering bug (blank transcript for the 424-message `cronkis` thread due to overshoot in `MessageList.svelte`'s estimateSize), plus missing focus traps on Settings/SessionTree modals, stripped focus outlines, and per-tick re-highlighting of streaming messages.
decisions: Treated the audit as editorial work — pulled design tokens from Gizmo's existing `vesper-dark` theme (#101010 canvas, #ffc799 accent) and authored the report in that palette rather than introducing a new one.
Distinguished defects from judgment calls: kept the 5,400-line global CSS tree and prop-drilled store as observations, not recommendations, because both appear intentional.
Sequenced remediation with the highest leverage per line first: focus rings (ten-line fix removing a WCAG failure) before the blank transcript bug.
errors: Blank transcript on the `cronkis` thread: measured `scrollTop 36833 / scrollHeight 38132 / clientHeight 1299` with "Jump to latest" visible at the same time, indicating `followOutput=false` while `isAtBottom()=true`. Root cause is `estimateSize` returning a flat 220px against real row heights of 800–1500px, with `measure()` and `scrollToEnd()` firing on the same tick (`MessageList.svelte` ~60–72).
